name: Schluter Kerdi vs Liquid Membrane: Two Ways to Keep Water Out
title-tag: Schluter Kerdi vs Liquid Membrane: Which Waterproofing?
meta-description: Schluter Kerdi vs liquid membranes for shower waterproofing: where each wins, how each fails, and why installer fluency plus a 24-hour flood test decides it.
post-summary: February 23, 2027 · Schluter Kerdi and liquid membranes are both legitimate shower waterproofing - the sheet's risk lives at the seams, the liquid's in application thickness. Here is where each one wins, how each one fails, and why the installer's fluency and a photographed 24-hour flood test matter more than the brand.
